info.description: A multi-tenant Blog API with JWT authentication and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
info.title: Blog REST API

get.description: Moderation list of author requests across all users (Admin only)

parameters.description: Filter by status: pending, approved, rejected
parameters.name: status

patch.description: Approve or reject a pending author request. Approving automatically elevates user to author role (Admin only).

get.description: Lists all posts across all authors and statuses (Admin role required)

delete.description: Deletes a comment (Comment author, Post author, or Admin)

post.description: Upload an image file (cover image, inline asset) up to 5MB (Author or Admin role required)

parameters.description: Image file to upload (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF)
parameters.name: file

get.description: Lists all posts created by the authenticated author, including drafts and published posts
Browse published blog posts with search, tag filtering, and cursor pagination

parameters.description: Number of posts to return (default 10, max 20)
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Creates a draft or published post (Author or Admin role required)

get.description: Fetch post details by slug. Published posts are public; draft posts require author or admin credentials.
get.summary: Get a single post by slug

get.description: Fetch post details. Published posts are public; draft posts require author or admin credentials.
get.summary: Get a single post by ID

delete.description: Deletes a post. Authors can only delete their own posts; Admins can delete any post.

patch.description: Partially update a post's title, content, or status. Authors can only update their own posts; Admins can update any post.

get.description: Browse paginated comments on a published post

parameters.description: Number of comments to return (default 10, max 20)
parameters.name: limit

post.description: Add a new comment or nested reply to a published post (authenticated users)
post.summary: Add a comment to a post

get.description: Check whether the current user liked the post and get total likes count
get.summary: Get like status for a post

post.description: Likes a post if not currently liked, or removes the like if already liked (authenticated users)
Authenticates user credentials and returns a JWT Bearer token
Logs out the user session and revokes refresh tokens
Exchanges an active refresh token for a new access token and rotated refresh token
Creates a new user account (defaults to reader role)

get.description: Check service availability, database connectivity, and system time
Retrieves the authenticated user's latest author application and status

post.description: Allows an authenticated reader to apply for author status with a bio and sample portfolio links
post.summary: Submit application to become an author

patch.description: Updates current user password and invalidates active refresh tokens

get.description: Returns details of the currently authenticated user

patch.description: Update current user's profile details (first name, last name, bio, avatar)

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and your JWT token. Example: "Bearer eyJhbGciOi..."
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
